findings.issue: One-word verdict on the remains examined in this scene. Another line in the same namespace agrees with them as a non-human plural ('لم تُمسّ', feminine), so the masculine بشري here has nothing to agree with and reads as describing a single male person.

findings.source_en: Is this your Great Old One?
findings.issue: 'the Great Old One' is a title, rendered العظيم القديم as a fixed unit in the three sibling rows of this memory (the lair of / I know the way to / must be displeased). Turning it into the possessive عظيمك القديم reads as 'your old chief' rather than as the god's name.
